task: Continue contact-changing finite-horizon terminal recovery while preserving markerless human whole-body imitation targets
method: 32 deterministic withdrawal schedules, full 29-DoF G1 dynamics for 4 s, batched policy prediction, actual CPU-controller verification before selection. Independent robot state/history branches. No future human observations; only terminal withdrawal.

configuration.assumptions: Exact simulator state/history, same nominal model and offline frozen physical time during planning. Not a hardware or real-time controller.

selection_freeze.decision: No default promotion. Three development cases yielded two nominal plans and no recovery for straight walking. Select CPU after full-plan timing; add fixed velocity sensitivity diagnostics without using them for candidate selection. Freeze before seven other known-scene regressions; this is not independent unseen testing.

freeze.selection: Keep previously selected schedule; no new search or parameter update
freeze.scope: Independent copies of target robot simulation model. No source truth, hardware or calibrated uncertainty.

device_evidence.microbenchmark_method: 32 observations from a standing robot plus deterministic small Gaussian observation noise. 10 warmups, 50 repetitions, fixed one-thread CPU, CUDA TF32 disabled. Not camera latency.
device_evidence.timing_scope: Exploratory sequential runs, not a controlled statistical speedup claim. GPU full run predates contact-diagnostic correction; dynamics and candidate schedules identical. CPU chosen because GPU did not improve complete planning latency.

cuda_execution.scope: Two 32-observation runs; execution-provider proof only, not a latency measurement.

limitations: All scenes and people have been evaluated in earlier rounds; no independent unseen data claim.
The new gain is one nominal-model low-light terminal stop; +10% robot mass or +25% geom friction causes that selected schedule to fall.
No admissible schedule in 32 candidates does not prove that recovery is impossible; explicit foot placement/time and angular momentum are not optimized.
Planning freezes simulation time for seconds, so this cannot serve as an online 50Hz or hardware controller.
Initial velocity and model stress cases are fixed diagnostics, not a calibrated uncertainty guarantee.
Full source imitation remains failed in all ten cases. Rotation/contact observability, root tracking and on-device feedback remain unresolved.
Overall replay initial alignment uses the first valid saved reference; the planner itself reads no future source frame.
